snippet.title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 | Rebirth Expansion | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A new era has begun! Unleash 4 movie themed species, experience a full narrative campaign inspired by Jurassic World: Rebirth and enhance your locations with a range of detailed scenery pieces! 

The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion is available NOW! 

Learn more: https://fron.dev/95ed

Build your own Jurassic World. Nurture generations of dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options. Available now on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
